verdict.rationale: Jira's docs describe Rovo AI features (creating automations, breaking down tasks, surfacing trends) that imply natural-language AI assistance, and an official MCP server exists that could let AI agents issue natural-language commands to Jira. However, there is no direct documentation or hands-on evidence of a chat/NL command interface actually driving Jira actions end-to-end. Missing for 10: concrete first-party documentation of a natural-language command interface, hands-on/independent verification that Rovo AI or MCP-based commands work as described.
